items.title: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
items.description: Houthi forces are trying to secure high ground and solidify their control of the entry to the Red Sea in the southwest. The Iran-backed militia abandoned a shaky truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July.

items.description: Authorities claimed Novaya Gazeta opposed the invasion of Ukraine and spread “false information” about elections.

items.title: How growing Israeli-Turkish tensions led to a strike on a Syrian air base
items.description: Could the growing regional rivalry between Turkey and Israel lead to a military clash? A recent Israeli strike on an air base in northern Syria illustrated the two countries’ conflicting strategic interests, but analysts say neither wants war.

items.title: Outside forces fuel Sudan war, new report finds
items.description: Foreign recruitment and external support networks are fuelling the brutal conflict in Sudan, independent UN human rights investigators said on Thursday in a new report, calling for accountability as fighting continues between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF).

items.title: Why Was There A Shoot-Out In Kyiv Between Security and Intelligence Agents?
items.description: An armed clash between Ukraine’s military intelligence and security service left three officers wounded in Kyiv. Both sides gave conflicting accounts, while President Zelenskyy called the incident “absolutely disgraceful.”
